ITEM.PTXT: The non-operating conditions are as follows.

ENTRY.PTXT: Pre-crash Safety System
When the vehicle speed is 5km/h or less
When IG-OFF or IG-ACC
When there is a system malfunction
When the pre-crash sensor cannot detect an object as a collision object
When colliding with an object outside the pre-crash sensor detection area
Pre-crash Seat Belt
Common
When the pre-crash system is not operating
When the seat belt is not fastened
Brake Linked
When the vehicle speed is 30km/h or less
Radar Linked
When the relative speed with the collision object is 30km/h or less
Pre-crash Brake Assist
When the pre-crash system is not operating
When the vehicle speed is 30km/h or less
When the driver does not depress the brake
Pre-crash Brake
When the pre-crash system is not operating
When the vehicle speed is 15km/h or less
When the pre-crash brake OFF switch is ON

ITEM.PTXT: When the system cannot operate due to a system malfunction, "PCS system check" and "PCS currently unavailable" are displayed on the multi-information display.
Plastic objects such as pylons cannot be detected. In addition, people, bicycles, motorcycles, standing trees, animals, snow walls, etc. may be difficult to detect.
The millimeter wave radar detects collision objects within a range of ±10° vertically and horizontally from the front of the radar. Therefore, it does not operate in side or rear collisions.
